sections.title: The letter agá
paragraphs: The letter name is (agá) /aˈɡa/. It has no sound on its own. You write it in (hotel) /ɔˈtɛl/, which is a place where travelers stay. It has only one way to be used.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Do not move your mouth to make any sound. Keep your tongue relaxed. Let the air pass without any sound from your throat. Your vocal cords do not make any sound. Put your hand on your throat. You feel no movement at all before the vowel begins.

sections.title: When it is silent
paragraphs: A silent letter is a letter that you write but do not say. In all positions as an isolated letter, this letter is not pronounced. You do not say it at the start of (hora) /ˈɔ.ɾɐ/ or (hoje) /ˈo.ʒɨ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not breathe out like the first sound in hat. Start at once with the vowel sound, like in the English word hour.
